theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The only theme showing the full confirmed-trend structure: eligible under the absolute-trend gate (the one validated risk-control leg), highest score, highest durability_bar (0.71), and 93% breadth — a leader with cohesion, not just a price spike. Crowding_z=1.19 and crowded=true are a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade, per guardrails. My lean is a tilt toward the theme that passes the staying-power gate, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowded=true with one_narrative dominance is exactly the reflexivity setup where the leading theme gets oversubscribed and mean-reverts; the absolute-trend gate controls drawdown risk but has NO mean-return edge, so the overweight may produce muted returns even if it avoids a shake-out.

theses.dissent: Its score (0.635) is far below the energy leader, and breadth of only 0.429 suggests the theme is only half-engaged — it may be a laggard with negative relative momentum against the dominant one-narrative energy regime.

theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate still marks it eligible, meaning it has not broken down into a drawdown regime; avoiding it forfeits exposure to a theme that is still technically in the trend bucket and could resume leadership if the one-narrative energy trade unwinds.
